info.title: Expense Tracker API
info.description: REST API of the Expense Tracker. Every path except `/health` is under `/api/v1`. Errors use `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details" } }`; see `ErrorResponse` for the enumerated codes. Lists use `{ "data": [...], "meta": { "page", "limit", "total" } }`. Sign-out has no endpoint: the client removes the stored token (ADR-0003).

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Google sign-in, session, profile, deletion and restoration.

tags.name: test-only
tags.description: Automation support (ADR-0005). Mounted only when APP_ENV is test or staging; these operations do not exist in production.

bearerAuth.description: System session token returned by `POST /api/v1/auth/google`, valid for 7 days. Rejected with 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED` when missing, malformed, altered or expired, or when its account does not exist or is pending deletion.

testAuthSecret.name: X-Test-Auth-Secret
testAuthSecret.description: Secret of the test-only router (ADR-0005). Not configured in production.

token.description: System session token: an HS256-signed JWT whose claims are limited to `sub` (the account `id`), `iat` and `exp`. It is valid for 7 days from issuance, there is no refresh token, and it is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

expiresAt.description: Expiry of the token (its `exp` claim): issuance plus 7 days.

SessionResponse.description: A new session for an active account.

email.description: Email obtained from Google; for display only.

name.description: Display name obtained from Google, refreshed at each sign-in.

avatarUrl.description: Avatar URL obtained from Google, or `null` when Google provides none.

AccountStatus.description: Account status. Every successful response carries `active`.

path.description: Dot-separated location of the invalid value, prefixed by its source (`body`, `query`, `params` or `headers`).

message.description: Human-readable English description, for logs and diagnostics only.

details.description: Empty for every code except `VALIDATION_ERROR` and `ACCOUNT_PENDING_DELETION`.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error format of every non-2xx response.

ErrorCode.description:
Stable error code. Status and meaning:
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (400): the body, query, parameters or headers failed validation; `details` lists the issues.
- `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401): the bearer token is missing, malformed, altered or expired, or its account no longer exists or is pending deletion; on the test-only router, the `X-Test-Auth-Secret` header is missing or incorrect.
- `INVALID_GOOGLE_TOKEN` (401): the Google ID token failed verification (signature, expiry, audience or issuer); the message never states which check failed.
- `FORBIDDEN` (403): the authenticated account may not perform the operation (test-only router: the account is not a test account).
- `ACCOUNT_PENDING_DELETION` (403): the Google identity belongs to an account pending deletion within the recovery period; no session is issued and `details[0]` carries the remaining time.
- `NOT_FOUND` (404): the path does not exist (including the test-only router where it is not mounted).
- `ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND` (404): no restorable account exists for the Google identity (none exists, or the recovery period has expired).
- `ACCOUNT_NOT_PENDING_DELETION` (409): restoration was requested for an account that is active.
- `RATE_LIMITED` (429): the per-IP request limit of the endpoint is exhausted; see the `Retry-After` header.
- `INTERNAL_ERROR` (500): unexpected server error; no internal detail is disclosed.

ErrorDetail.description: Structured detail of the error; its shape depends on `code`.

PendingDeletionErrorResponse.description: Signals an account pending deletion within the recovery period (UC-01 A2). No session is issued and no account data is returned.

remainingDays.description: Whole days remaining before permanent deletion, rounded down: floor((deletionRequestedAt + 30 days - now) / 24 h). The value 0 means that less than one day remains.

permanentDeletionAt.description: deletionRequestedAt plus 30 days; from this instant the account is treated as permanently deleted.

PendingDeletionDetail.description: Remaining recovery time of an account pending deletion (UC-04).

idToken.description: Google ID token (JWT) obtained by the web application from Google Identity Services. Verified on the server (signature, expiry, audience equal to `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, Google issuer); never logged.

GoogleSignInRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/v1/auth/google`. Unknown properties are rejected.

idToken.description: Google ID token (JWT) obtained by the web application from Google Identity Services. Verified on the server (signature, expiry, audience equal to `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, Google issuer); never logged.

RestoreAccountRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/v1/auth/restore`: the Google ID token that was presented to `POST /api/v1/auth/google` and answered with `ACCOUNT_PENDING_DELETION`, re-sent while it is unexpired. Unknown properties are rejected.

userKey.description: Caller-chosen key of the test account; the account's `googleId` is `test|<userKey>`. The same key reuses the same account.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to `Test User <userKey>` on creation; when supplied for an existing account it overwrites the stored name, as a Google sign-in does.

email.description: Email. Defaults to `<userKey>@test.invalid` on creation; when supplied for an existing account it overwrites the stored email.

TestTokenRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/v1/test/auth/token`. Unknown properties are rejected.

post.summary: Exchange a Google ID token for a session (UC-01)
post.description:
Verifies the Google ID token and identifies the account by the Google subject identifier, never by email (BR-01). Name, email and avatar are refreshed from the token.
- Active account: 200 with a 7-day session.
- No account for the identifier: the account (status `active`, currency VND) and the 11 default categories are created (FR-02, FR-03, BR-08); 201 with a session.
- Account pending deletion for fewer than 30 days: 403 `ACCOUNT_PENDING_DELETION`, no session (UC-01 A2).
- Account pending deletion for 30 days or more: the old account and all its data are deleted and a new account is initialised; 201 with a session and no restoration signal (UC-01 A3, BR-15).

Rate limit: at most 5 requests in any 60 minutes and at most 10 requests in any 24 hours per client IP address, over rolling windows (NFR-03); every request counts, whatever its outcome.
Neither the Google ID token nor the issued token is logged (NFR-06).

200.description: Signed in to an existing active account.

201.description: A new account was initialised (first sign-in, or sign-in after the recovery period expired) and signed in.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR`: the body is not JSON, a required property is missing or invalid, or an unknown property is present.

401.description: `INVALID_GOOGLE_TOKEN`: the ID token has an invalid signature, has expired, or carries a wrong audience or issuer. The message is generic and does not state which check failed.

403.description: `ACCOUNT_PENDING_DELETION`: the account is pending deletion and fewer than 30 days have elapsed since the request. No session is issued. The client shows the restoration dialog with `details[0].remainingDays` and keeps the Google ID token in memory for `POST /api/v1/auth/restore`; declining requires no request.

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: the limit of this endpoint is exhausted: at most 5 requests in any 60 minutes and at most 10 requests in any 24 hours per client IP address, over rolling windows (NFR-03); every request counts, whatever its outcome. The client suggests trying again later. The `Retry-After` header is listed in `Access-Control-Expose-Headers`, so a cross-origin client from an allowed origin can read it.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next request from this address can be accepted. Exposed to allowed cross-origin clients through `Access-Control-Expose-Headers`.

get.description: Returns only the account identified by the token; reads do not modify the account. Also serves as the session check of the web application.

401.description: `UNAUTHENTICATED`: the bearer token is missing, malformed, altered or expired, or the account does not exist or is pending deletion. The client clears the stored token and returns to the sign-in screen.

delete.summary: Request deletion of the authenticated account (UC-03)
delete.description: Sets the status to `pending_deletion` and records the request instant (UTC). Every token of the account is rejected with 401 from then on, so the session ends; the client also removes its stored token. The account and its data are permanently deleted 30 days later unless restored. No request body.

401.description: `UNAUTHENTICATED`: the bearer token is missing, malformed, altered or expired, or the account does not exist or is pending deletion. The client clears the stored token and returns to the sign-in screen.

post.description:
Verifies the Google ID token exactly as `POST /api/v1/auth/google` does. When the account is pending deletion for fewer than 30 days, sets its status to `active`, clears the request instant, leaves all categories and transactions unchanged, and returns a session (FR-09).
No bearer token is involved: an account pending deletion never holds a valid session.

Rate-limited per client IP address with the same windows as `POST /api/v1/auth/google`, counted separately.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR`: the body is not JSON, a required property is missing or invalid, or an unknown property is present.

401.description: `INVALID_GOOGLE_TOKEN`: the ID token failed verification, typically because it expired while the dialog was open. The client returns to the sign-in screen.

404.description: `ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND`: no account exists for the Google identity, or the recovery period of 30 days has expired and the account has been permanently deleted. No session is issued. The client returns the Guest to the sign-in screen; a subsequent `POST /api/v1/auth/google` initialises a new account.

409.description: `ACCOUNT_NOT_PENDING_DELETION`: the account is already active (for example, restored from another tab or device). The account is not modified and no session is issued. The client returns the Guest to the sign-in screen, because the Google ID token held for restoration may have expired; a session is obtained only through a new `POST /api/v1/auth/google`.

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: the limit of this endpoint is exhausted: at most 5 requests in any 60 minutes and at most 10 requests in any 24 hours per client IP address, over rolling windows (NFR-03); every request counts, whatever its outcome. Counted separately from `POST /api/v1/auth/google`. The client suggests trying again later. The `Retry-After` header is listed in `Access-Control-Expose-Headers`, so a cross-origin client from an allowed origin can read it.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next request from this address can be accepted. Exposed to allowed cross-origin clients through `Access-Control-Expose-Headers`.

post.summary: Issue a session for a test account (test and staging only)
post.description:
Test-only (ADR-0005). This operation does not exist in production. The router is mounted only when `APP_ENV` is `test` or `staging`, `TEST_AUTH_ENABLED` is `true` and `TEST_AUTH_SECRET` holds at least 32 characters; otherwise the path returns 404 `NOT_FOUND` like any unknown path. Every request presents the secret in the `X-Test-Auth-Secret` header (constant-time comparison). Rate-limited to 600 requests per client IP address in any 60 minutes.

Creates or reuses the account whose `googleId` is `test|<userKey>`, applies the same rules as `POST /api/v1/auth/google` (initialisation with the default categories, 403 for an account pending deletion, re-initialisation after the recovery period), and returns a session token identical in form to that of `POST /api/v1/auth/google`.

201.description: Test account initialised and signed in.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR`: the body is not JSON, a required property is missing or invalid, or an unknown property is present.

401.description: `UNAUTHENTICATED`: the `X-Test-Auth-Secret` header is missing or incorrect, or (where required) the bearer token is invalid; the response does not state which.

403.description: `ACCOUNT_PENDING_DELETION`: the account is pending deletion and fewer than 30 days have elapsed since the request. No session is issued. The client shows the restoration dialog with `details[0].remainingDays` and keeps the Google ID token in memory for `POST /api/v1/auth/restore`; declining requires no request.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: the test-only router is not mounted in this environment.

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: the limit of this endpoint is exhausted: at most 600 requests in any 60 minutes per client IP address. The client suggests trying again later. The `Retry-After` header is listed in `Access-Control-Expose-Headers`, so a cross-origin client from an allowed origin can read it.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next request from this address can be accepted. Exposed to allowed cross-origin clients through `Access-Control-Expose-Headers`.

delete.summary: Permanently delete the authenticated test account (test and staging only)
delete.description:
Test-only (ADR-0005). This operation does not exist in production. The router is mounted only when `APP_ENV` is `test` or `staging`, `TEST_AUTH_ENABLED` is `true` and `TEST_AUTH_SECRET` holds at least 32 characters; otherwise the path returns 404 `NOT_FOUND` like any unknown path. Every request presents the secret in the `X-Test-Auth-Secret` header (constant-time comparison). Rate-limited to 600 requests per client IP address in any 60 minutes.

Immediately and permanently deletes the account identified by the bearer token and all of its categories and transactions, without a recovery period. Accepts the token of a test account in either status, so that a test that requested deletion can still clean up. Refuses any account whose `googleId` does not start with `test|`.

401.description: `UNAUTHENTICATED`: the `X-Test-Auth-Secret` header is missing or incorrect, or (where required) the bearer token is invalid; the response does not state which.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN`: the account is not a test account; nothing is deleted.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: the test-only router is not mounted in this environment, or the account no longer exists.

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: the limit of this endpoint is exhausted: at most 600 requests in any 60 minutes per client IP address. The client suggests trying again later. The `Retry-After` header is listed in `Access-Control-Expose-Headers`, so a cross-origin client from an allowed origin can read it.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next request from this address can be accepted. Exposed to allowed cross-origin clients through `Access-Control-Expose-Headers`.
